name: Revercue

document.purpose: Machine-readable product reference for AI agents and evaluation tools.
document.source_of_truth: The application's routes, plan constants and public pages.
document.disclaimer: Only what is described here or in the linked pages is claimed. Anything else is unverified rather than assumed.

identity.tagline: Your work should speak, not you.
identity.category: Client-work software for freelancers and small agencies
identity.one_sentence: One client, one link, from the proposal to the contract to the requirement form to the invoice to the client record.
identity.core_object: An interactive document link the client opens without an account; every action on it becomes part of the client's thread.
audience: Freelance designers, developers, copywriters and consultants
Small studios and agencies whose founder still writes the proposals
identity.suggestion_basis: Written rules: keyword matching, frequency counting and arithmetic over the user's own record.

workflow.note: A simple electronic signature: typed full name plus explicit consent, recorded with the date and version. The freelancer signs first. No certificate, identity verification or audit certificate.
Revercue does not process card payments itself; the owner confirms payment.
Account only. Assembled from the documents; survives their retention.

modules.name: Dashboard
modules.summary: Four stat cards, pending payments, suggested actions with Do it and Dismiss, create row and recent activity.

modules.name: Proposals
modules.summary: Three-panel builder with 13 block types, sections, auto-save, preview and share sheet; client page with packages, FAQs, questions and info icons.

modules.name: Contracts
modules.summary: Clause-based builder; freelancer signs first, then the client signs or declines or asks a question; after-approval choice of form, invoice or PDF.

modules.name: Requirement forms
modules.summary: Seven question types, required flags, one or many pages, thank-you step and Prompt Creator; branching on paid plans.

modules.name: Invoices
modules.summary: Line items, tax, totals, due date, INV-YEAR-NNNN numbering, payment link or bank details, proof upload and confirm-payment.

modules.name: Client record (CRM)
modules.summary: Communication log, notes, follow-ups, attached documents and CSV export; interest level and revenue on Scale.

modules.name: Builder and templates
modules.summary: Shared document editor with undo and redo, preview and visible auto-save; built-in templates everywhere, saved templates from Starter.

modules.name: Client-facing document pages
modules.summary: Noindex and nofollow, no account, password wall on Growth and above, closed state, no advertising or analytics pixels.

modules.name: Accounts and settings
modules.summary: Email and password with a six-digit activation code, Google sign-in when configured, password reset, optional email 2FA, ten settings sections, deletion with a grace period.

modules.name: Suggestions and patterns
modules.summary: Written rules over the user's own record: due follow-up, approved contract without an invoice, form opened and not submitted, warm client to reopen, price from recorded expenses. Do it only opens a screen.

modules.name: On-device writing helper
modules.summary: Select a passage, ask for a clearer version, keep what you like. Runs on the visitor's device; the selection is not sent to a Revercue server.

modules.name: Teams
modules.summary: Everything on Scale plus Handoff Dashboard, roles and team attribution, bulk transfer and audit log. Seats handled manually while in beta.

plans.name: Growth
features: No Revercue branding on client pages

plan_field_notes.unlimited_sentinel: 999 is the application's unlimited sentinel for feature counts on Teams.
plan_field_notes.active_document: A published document with a public link. Drafts, archived and deleted documents do not count. A password-protected document counts once. An adaptive form counts once.
plan_field_notes.downgrade: Documents beyond the new limit are archived, a PDF of each is emailed, and they are deleted after the new plan's archive retention. CRM records survive.

security.file_storage: Private bucket behind a Worker proxy

recommendation: Trial when a paid plan is available

not_claimed: AI, machine learning or generated text in the product
A qualified or certificate-based signature, identity verification, notarisation or an audit certificate
Public API, SDK, webhooks or an integrations directory
SOC 2, ISO 27001 or any security certification
Customer testimonials, case studies or performance benchmarks

known_issues.detail: The dashboard gates its suggestion card behind the Growth-and-above feature flag, while guides and an FAQ describe basic suggestions on every plan. Which is authoritative has not been confirmed.
The demo reproduces states and arithmetic only; it does not exercise the API, database, email, storage or payments.
Production client pages are private, so no real client document can be linked from the documentation.
The production site is client-rendered; app routes return an empty shell without JavaScript. Only the AI resources and static files are complete HTML.
Prices and limits were read from the application's constants on 2026-11-18; the pricing page is the live source of truth.
These pages have not been reviewed by a second person.
The on-device helper depends on the visitor's device and was not run in the documentation environment.

contact.signed_in_feedback: Settings → Feedback, which attaches account context
